newsitem.title: USA: MONSANTO SETS PAYOUT FOR CHEMICAL SPINOFF.
newsitem.headline: MONSANTO SETS PAYOUT FOR CHEMICAL SPINOFF.

text.p: Monsanto Co, which has planned to spin off its chemicals businesses, said Tuesday its directors voted a dividend of one share of common stock in a new chemicals company for each five shares of Monsanto common stock held on the record date of August 20, 1997.

Payment of the dividend requires shareholder approval of the spinoff of its chemical business at a special meeting to be held on August 18, 1997. The spinoff if it is approved, is expected to occur on September 1, 1997.
Last December, Monsanto's board approved a plan to spin off the company's chemical businesses and form two separately traded, publicly-held companies.
One company, a life sciences company, will have $5 billion in sales and serve the agriculture, food and health care markets.
The other company, a chemical company, will have about $3 billion in revenues and will make and market chemical based products.
Shares of Monsanto were trading up 3/4 to 46-3/4.
